label: Casual
notes: Everyday relaxed wear — prioritize comfort and breathability. Kurtis, palazzo pants, casual salwar suits, or printed cotton sarees work perfectly. Keep it light and unfussy.
men_notes: Cotton kurta-pyjama or a kurta with jeans; pathani for evenings.

label: Office / Workwear
notes: Professional yet comfortable. Formal salwar suits, structured kurta-palazzo sets, cotton or crepe sarees in muted or solid tones. Avoid overly embellished or diaphanous fabrics. Prefer structured silhouettes.
men_notes: Shirt and trousers by default; a kurta with trousers or a Nehru jacket on festive days.

label: Wedding Guest
notes: Dress to impress without overshadowing the bride. Rich fabrics in jewel tones — lehenga cholis, anarkalis, silk sarees, or heavily embroidered salwar suits. Embellishment is appropriate. Gold or silver jewelry completes the look.
men_notes: Sherwani for the baraat and reception, bandhgala for sangeet, kurta-pyjama with a jacket by day.

label: Pooja / Prayer
notes: Modest, clean, and traditional. Traditional fabrics like cotton and silk are considered pure and appropriate for puja. Avoid synthetic fabrics. Regional pujas may have specific color requirements (e.g., yellow for Saraswati Puja).
men_notes: Cotton or silk kurta with dhoti or pyjama; nothing black.

label: Festival
notes: Festival dressing is about celebration. Choose fabrics that photograph beautifully and carry traditional weight. Heavy embellishments, zari work, and mirror embroidery are all welcome. Check festival-specific color codes.
men_notes: Silk kurta-pyjama with a Nehru jacket; sherwani only for the biggest nights.

label: Formal / Corporate Event
notes: Formal events require polished, structured looks. Silk, crepe, or georgette sarees in neutral or rich tones. Tailored salwar suits or structured anarkalis. Minimal to moderate embellishment.
men_notes: Bandhgala or a dark sherwani; shirt-trousers with a Nehru jacket works for corporate dinners.

label: Night Out
notes: Evening and party looks call for fabrics with sheen and drape. Deep jewel tones, metallic accents, and dramatic silhouettes are encouraged. Indo-western fusion pieces work beautifully for clubs and urban social events.
men_notes: Indo-western or a slim bandhgala; pathani for a relaxed evening.

label: College / Campus
notes: Practical and vibrant — campus wear should be comfortable for all-day activity. Printed kurtis, palazzo combos, jeans with ethnic tops, and casual salwar suits are campus staples. Machine-washable fabrics are a priority.
men_notes: Kurta with jeans, t-shirt and jeans, or a pathani.

label: Temple / Religious Visit
notes: Temple visits require modest, respectful attire. Natural fabrics like cotton and silk are traditionally considered auspicious. Conservative silhouettes — full-coverage salwar suits, traditional sarees, or long ethnic dresses. Many temples require a dupatta or head covering.
men_notes: Kurta with dhoti/veshti or pyjama; shoulders covered, no shorts.

label: Mehendi
notes: Daytime, outdoors, sitting for hours with wet henna: light fabrics, sleeves you can push up, yellow-green-orange palette. Avoid white (henna stains) and black.

label: Sangeet
notes: Evening, dancing: festive and glamorous — sequins, mirror work, bold colours. Lehenga or sharara you can move in; skip stiff silks.

label: Haldi
notes: Turmeric everywhere: old or inexpensive cottons in yellow/white; nothing precious, nothing that stains badly.

label: Baraat
notes: Groom's-side procession: ethnic festive with sparkle; comfortable enough to dance in the street. Sherwani or bandhgala for men.

label: Reception
notes: The most formal sub-event: designer or occasion wear, rich silks, statement jewellery. Saree or lehenga preferred; darker jewel tones photograph well at night.

label: Beach / Resort
notes: Sun, salt and humidity: light breathable fabrics, easy silhouettes, quick-dry. Cover-ups for shacks and temples nearby.

label: Hill Station / Trek
notes: Cold mornings and wind: layers over full-length bottoms, closed shoes, a warm shawl or jacket; skip sheer fabrics.
